title: altamiranoa guatemalensis
intro: Altamiranoa guatemalensis, commonly known as the Guatemalan forest mint, is a plant species in the mint family (Lamiaceae). This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health issues. Altamiranoa guatemalensis has been found to have potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce pain and inflammation, and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of Altamiranoa guatemalensis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities.
